ValidationRule.description: Requires the Opportunity Name to match the Account Name.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( RecordType.Name <> "Historical", RecordType.Name <> "Foundation Opportunity", Lower(Name) <> Lower(Account.Name), $User.FirstName <> "Integration", $User.Id <> "0055f000007uli3", IsClosed = false )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Opportunity Name must match Account Name.
